notes.title: AdventureX 2023 - Steam Event & Demo improvements
notes.content:
We are delighted to announce that Aurora: The Lost Medallion - The Cave has been showcased alongside a selection of extraordinary adventure games at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ASHGAMES/sale/adventurex2023]AdventureX 2023 Steam Event[/url]! Explore this fantastic convention, experience our updated demo, and, if you're captivated by what you see, consider adding Aurora: The Lost Medallion - The Cave to your Steam wishlist.

Thanks to our participation in this remarkable event and your feedback, we've been inspired to make significant changes and additions to our Demo, to enhance your gaming experience. 

Here's a sneak peek at what we've added:
[list]
[*] Greek language support.
[*] Updated Tutorial and Controls Menu with new icons and text.
[*] Viewable inventory objects have magnifying glasses over them.
[*] Flag icons were integrated into the Main Menu.
[*] Added Plus-minus buttons next to the Act synopsis title in the Journal.
[/list]
(Please note that old save games from the previous demo version won't work - Please delete them all.)

notes.title: Noema Games achievement hunt contest!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35201822/f5269f83dc3ccd76b42184e7cda42f4c7dabc518.jpg[/img]
We are proud to announce that achievements for the Aurora:The Lost Medallion Episode I Steam Demo are ready! We would also like to use this opportunity to announce this contest!

The first 3 players to find all achievements within the week will receive a FREE steam key for the full game when it is released! So put on your adventurer hats, take out your magnifying glasses, turn on your light bulbs and get searching!           
What are you waiting for?

The Rules: There are 25 achievements in total and most of them are secret. Many of them are not possible to unlock after certain steps in the game, so a lot of saving and loading will be required! Click on everything, use every possible interaction you can imagine!  If you find them all add Noema Games as a friend on Steam and we will announce the winners by the end of the week! 
P.S. Don't cheat...The vulture will know...

notes.title: Welcome to the community
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35201822/a34c0be4b4aa63c4ac0457169c4e5ebadb83850c.jpg[/img]

Aurora has finally gotten her own page on Steam and she couldn't be more excited.

We are proud to show some of the upcoming game to the steam community and we are pleasantly surprised by the flood of people who have added us to their wishlist already!

[b]Aurora: The lost medallion Episode I[/b], is a 2D, Point & Click, Sci-Fi, Fantasy, Adventure Game inspired by classics like Monkey Island and more modern titles, like Broken Age. The story unfolds in the Trappist-1 solar system, recently discovered by NASA and it features the quest of an alien girl to find her purpose in life. Below the frozen surface of planet Eedor, Aurora has spent her entire life in a technologically advanced cave, together with a group of other children. Without parents, but raised by robots and guided only by pre-recorded messages, the children spend their lives hiding from the ever-hungry vultures and work to sustain their underground society.

The next Festival of Colors is upon them, and Aurora is now of age.
This is the time for her to achieve her life long dream of becoming a Pilgrim and leaving the safe confines of the Cave. At the top of the Hollow Mountain, lies her chance to speak with the divine Voices and ask her only question: [b]"What is my Voice?"[/b]

If you fancy old-school point & click adventure games, with a deep and meaningful story and devoid of moon logic, this might be the game for you!

Add us to your steam [b]wishlist[/b] and check out our [b]demo[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1088610/Aurora_The_Lost_Medallion_Episode_I/
